newsitem.title: USA: Lithium plans offering worth $7-10 mln.
newsitem.headline: Lithium plans offering worth $7-10 mln.

text.p: Lithium Technology Corp said on Monday it planned to conduct a public offering of $7 million to $10 million worth of common stock to continue developing and manufacturing scale-up for lithium-polymer rechargeable batteries.

The company said it would file for registration shortly, and it expected the stock offering to occur in the fourth quarter or first quarter 1997. The underwriting was subject to certain conditions, including securing a $2 million private financing before the offering, and the production of working cells from the company's demonstration manufacturing line.

Proceeds would be used to accelerate Lithium's production schedule, including the purchase of capital equipment to upgrade its demonstration manufacturing line and working capital to complete development of its long run-time lithium-polymer batteries for notebook computers and wireless communications handsets, Lithium said.
Lithium said it signed a letter of agreement with a New York investment banking firm to underwrite the deal.
